comment: stage는 장면 속 주인공의 인생 단계(child/teen/adult/elder). child·teen 장면은 일반 등급만 가능하며 게임 코드가 생성 단계에서 다시 검사한다.

items.title: 요람 곁의 점술가
items.caption: 운명은 백면체 하나로 시작되었다.
items.prompt: fortune teller leaning over a wooden cradle at night, a glowing hundred-sided die in hand, candlelight, cozy cottage interior

items.title: 향신료 시장의 미아
items.caption: 사람 물결 속에서 처음으로 혼자가 되었다.
items.prompt: small child lost in a crowded harbor spice market, colorful awnings, a kind old merchant bending down, sacks of spices, seagulls

items.title: 울타리 너머의 눈
items.caption: 노란 눈 두 개와 막대기 하나.
items.prompt: small child holding a wooden stick at a snowy village fence, grey wolf with yellow eyes beyond the fence, winter dusk, sheep pen

items.title: 첨탑 아래의 불꽃
items.caption: 손끝에서 처음 튄 푸른빛.
items.prompt: small child with blue magical sparks dancing above the palm, tall wizard tower in the background, twilight city of spires

items.title: 창가의 겨울
items.caption: 열병이 남긴 것은 기침과 책 한 무더기였다.
items.prompt: small child sick in bed beside a frosty window, damp cloth on the forehead, stack of books on the blanket, pale winter light

items.title: 골목대장
items.caption: 그 골목에서 평생의 인연이 시작되었다.
items.prompt: two children facing each other in a narrow cobblestone alley, a bigger child blocking the way with crossed arms, long evening shadows

items.title: 뒷골목 주사위판
items.caption: 처음 들은 주사위 구르는 소리.
items.prompt: young teenager watching a back alley dice game, grown men gambling with copper coins on a barrel, lantern light, smoky alley

items.title: 폐광의 어둠
items.caption: 횃불 너머로 반짝인 것은 금화였을까.
items.prompt: young teenager holding a torch inside an abandoned mine tunnel, old wooden support beams, glint of old coins, deep shadows

items.title: 등불 축제의 밤
items.caption: 강물을 따라 흘러간 등불과 웃음소리.
items.prompt: summer night festival, paper lanterns floating on a river, villagers dancing in the town square, friends laughing together, warm glow

items.title: 세 개의 문
items.caption: 성인식 날, 세 개의 문 앞에 섰다.
items.prompt: young person standing before three great doors, merchant guild door with scales, adventurers guild door with crossed swords, wizard tower door with stars, ceremonial banners

items.title: 첫 가게
items.caption: 작지만 내 이름이 걸린 첫 간판.
items.prompt: adult merchant opening a small market stall at morning, brass scales and ledger, wooden sign, first customers arriving

items.title: 해적의 깃발
items.caption: 새벽 바다 위의 검은 깃발.
items.prompt: merchant ship boarded by pirates at dawn, black flag, crates of cargo, crashing waves, dramatic sky

items.title: 고블린 굴
items.caption: 녹슨 검과 첫 의뢰.
items.prompt: adventurer with a rusty sword at the mouth of a goblin cave, small green goblins with torches, misty forest

items.title: 용의 보물산
items.caption: 왕국 하나를 살 만한 금화 위에 잠든 용.
items.prompt: adventurer standing before the dragon on a mountain of gold coins, vast cavern, glittering treasure, golden light

items.title: 폭주한 마법진
items.caption: 이론상으로는 완벽했다.
items.prompt: mage thrown back by an exploding magic circle in a laboratory, shattered glass flasks, blue fire, swirling smoke

items.title: 왕궁 알현
items.caption: 황금 깃발 아래 무릎을 꿇은 날.
items.prompt: grand royal hall audience, adult kneeling before a throne, golden banners, courtiers watching, marble columns

items.title: 텅 빈 창고
items.caption: 간판이 내려간 날, 빗소리만 남았다.
items.prompt: adult sitting alone in an empty warehouse, closed shop sign, scattered ledgers, rain streaking the window, dim light

items.title: 국경의 전장
items.caption: 연기와 깃발, 그리고 방패 하나.
items.prompt: frontier battlefield, soldiers with spears and banners, smoke on the horizon, a lone figure holding a round shield

items.title: 회고록
items.caption: 한 생을 종이 위에 옮기는 밤.
items.prompt: elderly person writing a memoir at a desk by candlelight, stacks of manuscripts, quill pen, warm cluttered study

items.title: 마지막 이야기
items.caption: 사랑하는 이들에게 둘러싸여 들려준 이야기.
items.prompt: elderly person resting in bed surrounded by family, soft morning light, flowers by the window, peaceful atmosphere
